result.instructions: Tools for SureLC, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our producers have an E&O policy that expires this month?"; "List the appointment requests that are still open for one carrier."; "Show all licenses for the producer with NPN 1234567.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SureLC data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run surelc_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run surelc_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run surelc_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. surelc_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: surelc_list_changed_producers
tools.title: List changed producers
tools.description: List producers created or updated recently, with their key data (ids, names, NPN, status). Without `after`, SureLC returns the last 24 hours. Use this to find a producer id. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/.

after.description: Only records modified after this date or date/time (for example 2026-01-01).

branch_code.description: Only producers in this branch code.

tools.name: surelc_get_producer
tools.title: Get a producer
tools.description: Get one producer by SureLC id: name, NPN, status, branch and contact details. Personal fields are removed. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/{id}.

producer_id.description: SureLC numeric id, as returned by a list tool.

tools.name: surelc_list_producers_licenses
tools.title: List producer licenses
tools.description: List license records for all producers, changed after an optional date. Use it to find expiring or missing licenses. SureLC: GET /api/v2/producers/licenses.

after.description: Only records modified after this date or date/time (for example 2026-01-01).

producer_id.description: SureLC numeric id, as returned by a list tool.

tools.title: List one producer's appointments
